svg.title: G02-link-entry-signed-in-cannot-check
svg.desc: Arimo outlined design reference. Native iOS controls are schematic. Pasted value retained. The reference redacts the token only in the drawings; the native field stores the original user-entered value for editing and retry. Network failure does not mark the field invalid. Continue is busy while checking and unavailable for the malformed value. Keyboard dismissed in this reference.
